entry.title: The Lagacy Time Forgot
entry.summary:
Author: Princesa_de_las_sombras

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 51,664Chapters: 14/?Kudos: 140

Summary: Some encounters only seem like chance. Marinette Dupain-Cheng just hoped a school trip to Gotham would give her a few days away from the troubles chasing her in Paris. Damian Wayne, for his part, never imagined that one simple public appearance could turn his whole world upside down. But when their paths cross, both of them sense something between them they can't explain. Something old.Something impossible.Something that seems to have been waiting for them long before they were born. While Marinette tries to figure out what that strange connection means, and Damian struggles to understand why a stranger has suddenly become the most important person in his life, forces that stayed hidden for centuries slowly begin to stir. Because some secrets can stay buried for generations. But time never truly forgets.

entry.title: Lie Lie Lie
entry.summary:
Author: krono2011

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 348,065Chapters: 111/?Kudos: 1,777

Summary: Marinette Dupain-Cheng's life fell apart. Adrien's discovery that his father was Hawk Moth and that his girlfriend had lied destroyed their relationship. Her mother let her leave the city after Chrysalis's death, releasing her from despair. She didn't go to Shanghai. Uncle Wang needed help with his new restaurant. Goodbye, City of Love, hello Gotham, Capital of Crime. Damian Wayne does not get “dumped.” However, with the high-profile Wayne Gala looming and his brothers actively plotting to mock his solo status, he requires an immediate tactical maneuver: a pretend girlfriend. His designated target? Maps Mizoguchi. Approaching a familiar silhouette with raven hair beneath a tree, he coldly issues a command for a romantic alliance. However, when the girl turns around, he realizes it isn't Maps. Instead, it's a thoroughly bewildered French transfer student clutching a macaron. A lesser man would apologize for the mistake. Damian Wayne? He simply doubles down. She has the right hair color, and she is a variable he can control. “You,” he decides, utterly refusing to admit defeat. “You are an acceptable substitute. Don’t be late.”

entry.title: Betrayal Wears Many Faces
entry.summary:
Author: YukimuraShuusukeGirl

Rating: General AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 17,446Chapters: 3/?Kudos: 380

Summary: At eighteen, Marinette Dupain-Cheng is the Guardian of the Miraculouses, a successful designer under the pseudonym MDC, and completely alone. Lila's lies have destroyed her reputation, turned her friends against her, and made Paris suffocating. With Hawk Moth finally defeated, Marinette should be able to breathe—but instead, even her own parents have stopped believing her. When Wayne Enterprises offers her a collaboration program in Gotham, Marinette takes the chance to leave the toxicity behind and start over. What she doesn't expect is Damian Wayne: brilliant, dangerous, and somehow able to see past every mask she wears. As Marinette grows closer to the boy who brings her coffee every morning, Ladybug finds an unexpected connection with Robin on Gotham's streets. Two identities, one person, and a romance neither of them sees coming. For the first time in months, Marinette has the chance to build something for herself. But with secrets piling up and Damian getting far too close to the truth, she will have to decide whether starting over means continuing to hide—or finally trusting someone enough to let them see all of her.
